advisory.headline: Uplink interference on shared-1: change channel, not terminal
advisory.detail: The signal comes down from all three satellites and is seen at sites more than 7,000 km apart, so it enters on the satellite uplink. Every user of shared-1 on these satellites is affected; moving or shielding a ground terminal will not help.
actions: Move traffic on shared-1 to shared-2, which is clear on all three satellites
Pass the estimated position and ellipse to the spectrum manager
Keep captures running; the ellipse shrinks with every 5 s capture

verdict_reason: Seen at sites 7,400 km apart (Honolulu and Manila) through three satellites.

advisory.headline: Uplink interference on shared-2: change channel, not terminal
advisory.detail: A QPSK signal is relayed by all three satellites and seen from Hawaii to Manila, so it enters on the uplink. Two captures so far: the lines of position cross twice, and both crossings fit the measurements equally well.
actions: Move traffic on shared-2 to another clear channel
Treat the position as one of two until more captures or a third pair separate them
Do not act on the position alone while the ambiguity is unresolved

verdict_reason: Seen at sites 7,400 km apart through three satellites.

advisory.headline: Local interference at Busan on solo-pac: find or shield the source near the site
advisory.detail: Only Busan sees this signal. Seoul, Tokyo, Naha and Manila watch the same downlink with enough margin to see it and do not, so it is not on the satellite uplink: it enters at the Busan antenna or receiver.
actions: Search for a transmitter near the Busan antenna on 260.502 5 MHz
Check the Busan receive chain for a fault or intermodulation
Shield or filter the Busan antenna; other sites and users are not affected

verdict_reason: Seen only at Busan; Seoul, 325 km away, watches the same downlink with 14 dB of margin and does not see it.

advisory.headline: Not yet decided: seen at Honolulu only
advisory.detail: Hilo is the only other site that could see this signal and its node is offline, so nothing tells uplink from local yet. The other sites on 172 E are too far down the beam to see a signal this weak.
actions: Restore the Hilo node; the verdict follows within 5 s of its first spectrum frame

verdict_reason: Seen at one site only, and the one other capable site (Hilo) is offline.

tasking.message: No second satellite with a usable channel relays this frequency, so the emitter cannot be located.

advisory.headline: Uplink interference on solo-io, no longer seen
advisory.detail: Seen at Manila, Naha and Tokyo for five minutes; only one satellite relays solo-io, so it could not be located.
actions: Note the time in the shift log

verdict_reason: Seen at Manila and Tokyo, 3,000 km apart.

advisory.headline: Local carrier at Naha, closed by operator
advisory.detail: A test oscillator in the Naha equipment room; removed.

verdict_reason: Seen only at Naha; Manila and Tokyo were capable and did not see it.
